lines.text: Monument to graphic artists and painter

notes: Curved, scratched steel plaque at the Kārlis Padegs monument by a park fence, Riga, trilingual (lv/en/ru), with the Riga coat of arms below. Scratches cross some letters (e.g. the Л in КАРЛИСУ) but all text is readable. Note the plaque's own grammar 'graphic artists'. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
derivative: whole 3072x4080 HD picture as served by the Panoramax instance (byte-identical; the service blurs faces and number plates), not cropped

License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. whole 4080x3072 HD picture as served by the Panoramax instance (byte-identical; the service blurs faces and number plates), not cropped.
notes: Granite pavement plaque in Riga marking the first film screening, inlaid metal letters in a decorative Art Nouveau font (e/E and s shapes are unusual). The ļ in Brāļu is a stylised descending glyph; the comma below is merged into it. 'Parize' and 'Riga' show no macron on the i (Parīze/Rīga in standard spelling). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
derivative: whole 4080x3072 HD picture as served by the Panoramax instance (byte-identical; the service blurs faces and number plates), not cropped

notes: Brushed-steel label plate of the public artwork 'Rēgs' (The Ghost), Riga old town, trilingual. Only headings, author lines and URL are transcribed; the three small explanatory paragraphs (lv/en/ru, about the 'Art in the Public Space' programme of Boris and Ināra Teterev) are omitted. Reflections on the steel. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: maemolol
attribution: Photo: maemolol, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.openstreetmap.fr/#focus=pic&pic=551e3eee-d0c1-41fa-9195-df70f5f7c3a3. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 1995,57,3840,1440 of the 3840x2160 HD picture.
notes: Orange-and-white pawnshop fascia on a pink Art Nouveau building, Riga, plus a round projecting VITA LOMBARDS sign. Distractor: green 'Banknote / AIZDEVUMI / LOMBARDS' fascia and hanging sign on the left (a different pawnshop), 'UZPĒRKAM ZELTU!' window posters, no-entry sign. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

attribution: Photo: mapcomplete, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.mapcomplete.org/#focus=pic&pic=d35d36ed-3af4-4ba6-abf3-285168fb5eb2. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. whole 4080x3072 HD picture as served by the Panoramax instance (byte-identical; the service blurs faces and number plates), not cropped.
notes: Monument to Colonel Oskars Kalpaks, Esplanāde park, Riga: light incised capitals on a long black granite base. A third line reads LATVIJAS ARMIJAS PIRMAJAM KOMANDIERIM as far as can be seen, but any macron/cedilla marks are too faint to confirm, so it is not in lines. Quote on the right: 'KO VARU VĒL TEV, TĒVZEME, / PAR SIRDI VAIRĀK DOT... / A. EGLĪTIS' (distractor). Wide shot; text occupies a small part of the frame. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: Brass dedication plaque on the restored swan house in Riga ('the restored swan house was given to the city of Riga for its 800th anniversary by Andris Ārgalis, mayor of Riga 2000-2001'). Raised serif capitals with Latvian macrons and Ņ; frontal. The place name appears in the accusative (namiņu). location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
